title: Zesty Crunchy Portuguese Freekeh Tagine
description: A bright, spicy tagine that combines the nutty flavor of freekeh with crunchy vegetables and a citrusy finish. Perfect as a pescatarian hangover cure in just a 40 minute cook.
instructions: Rinse freekeh under cold water and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a tagine or heavy pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion and sauté until translucent.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add diced red bell pepper and cook for 2 minutes.
Sprinkle paprika, cumin, and cayenne pepper; stir to coat vegetables.
Pour in vegetable broth and add cooked chickpeas.
Add rinsed freekeh and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper, then add lemon zest.
Cover the tagine and simmer on low heat for 20 minutes.
Remove the lid, stir, and let it cook uncovered for 5 minutes to thicken.
Serve hot, garnished with extra lemon zest if desired.
